Support of standard office applications such as Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat, browsers as well CAD software. Ability to work onsite in Torrance, CA and support urgent engineering, manufacturing, facility, security, or business milestones as needed. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done” Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption Equal Opportunity Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
